summary: fix(admin-panel): batch account disable requests by body size
description:
Because:

- A refresh of /account-disable gave 404 without the dev proxy.
- 1000 long addresses made a body over the admin server 100 KiB limit.
- The page said that all tokens are revoked, and its error was not announced.

This commit:

- Serves index.html for /account-disable.
- Splits locators into batches of at most 1000 entries and 90,000 bytes.
- Gives the error paragraph role="alert".
- Says that OAuth access tokens stay valid until they expire.

Closes FXA-14950
